_readme: How scripts/graph-template-gaps.py turns a code graph's reachable sinks and route frameworks into template coverage. Data, not code: every judgement the gap report makes lives here so a reviewer can disagree with it line by line. `sink_rules` maps each rule id of the graph's sink catalogue to the vulnerability capabilities a template would have to probe; `callee_refinements` re-read a sink by the call it makes, where one catalogue rule bundles different exposures; `class_fallback` covers a rule this file does not list yet (the report names it, so the map can be extended). A template COVERS a capability when it is in the pool (`template_pool`) and its terms match: its declared tags (`@tags`, or YAML `tags`) against `tags`, or, for a template that declares no tags, the CWE ids and words in its first 50 lines against `cwe` and `tags`. An `ecosystem_specific` capability also needs the template to name the reaching code's ecosystem (or no ecosystem at all). `pinned` and `not_coverage` override the term match for one template, each with the reason a reviewer can check.

extra_templates.mongodb-injection-deep: Lives under databases/ but drives NoSQL operator injection through the application's HTTP parameters, which is the shape a reached document-store sink needs.

code_injection.label: Code / expression evaluation injection
code_injection.why_ecosystem: An evaluation payload is written in the target's own language (a JavaScript expression for Node's eval, a Python one for eval).

insecure_deserialization.label: Insecure deserialisation over HTTP
insecure_deserialization.why_ecosystem: A gadget payload is a serialisation format of one runtime (Java object streams, Python pickle, YAML tags, node-serialize).

ssti.label: Server-side template injection
ssti.why_ecosystem: SSTI payloads are engine syntax: a Jinja2 probe proves nothing about Go text/template or EJS.

path_traversal.label: Path traversal / file disclosure by path

weak_hash.label: Weak hash (MD5 / SHA-1) on a reachable path

crypto_integrity.label: Signed / encrypted value tampering and token randomness

callee_refinements.why: Several catalogue rules (java.crypto, js.crypto_libs) bundle JWT libraries with ciphers; a JWT call is JWT exposure, which the jwt templates probe.
A hash rule covers MD5 and SHA-256 alike; only the call says which.

express.label: Express
express.would_check: prototype pollution through qs/body-parser, stack traces in the default error handler, X-Powered-By disclosure

koa.label: Koa
koa.would_check: koa-body prototype pollution and upload handling

fastify.label: Fastify
fastify.would_check: content-type parser confusion and schema-bypass on body validation

hono.label: Hono
hono.would_check: router path-normalisation differences behind a proxy

flask.label: Flask
flask.would_check: Werkzeug debug console exposure and session-cookie forgery from a weak SECRET_KEY

fastapi.label: FastAPI
fastapi.would_check: /docs and /openapi.json exposure that maps the full parameter surface

connexion.label: Connexion (OpenAPI-routed Flask)
connexion.would_check: exposed OpenAPI spec and Swagger UI, and operations whose spec omits a security requirement

django.label: Django
django.would_check: DEBUG=True technical error pages, exposed admin, and session forgery from a leaked SECRET_KEY

gorilla_mux.label: gorilla/mux
gorilla_mux.would_check: path-cleaning redirects that bypass a prefix-scoped auth middleware

net_http.label: Go net/http
net_http.would_check: ServeMux path-cleaning redirects and pattern-precedence auth bypass

httprouter.label: httprouter
httprouter.would_check: trailing-slash and fixed-path redirects that skip a per-route auth check

spring.label: Spring
spring.would_check: actuator endpoint exposure, Spring4Shell-class data binding

ssti-engine-fingerprint.reason: Fingerprints Jinja2, Mako, Twig, Smarty, Freemarker, Velocity, ERB, Handlebars and Pug; its tags name only some of them, and none of its payloads target Go templates.

server-side-js-injection.reason: Declares no tags; its header lists EJS/Pug/Handlebars template-evaluation payloads among its vectors.

insecure_deserialization.deserialization-gadget-scan: Probes raw TCP services (RMI, JMX) for Java serialisation magic bytes; it never sends a serialised object to an HTTP route, which is where a route-reached ObjectInputStream takes its input.
